observed_content: Restrict finite Schrödinger model for quadratic U=F_p^2 with Q=x²+y² to determinant-isotypic subspaces of C[U^m]. Numerically test Fourier and quadratic phase operators on each slot and GL shear on m=2. Commutant of compressed generators has dimension 1 for p=5,m=1 (d=1), and p=3,m=2 (d=6), supporting irreducibility under these generators.
claims: Two first-occurrence determinant-isotypic spaces irreducible under tested unitary generators to numerical tolerance.
hypotheses: Compute exact cyclotomic certificates and higher-rank cases; inspect theta-lift irreducibility and occurrence under larger fields.
ancestry_status: UNKNOWN: target-aware classical analogue, no traceable corpus-to-paper relationship
limitations: Only two finite first-occurrence cases; floating-point SVD rather than exact cyclotomic proof; no full presentation check for Sp(2m,F_p), global automorphic theta lifting or RH proof.
